package.name: Quartermaster
package.description: A per-chat RPG character sheet and inventory manager: equip slots, item locations, saved outfits, portrait and item images, and a read-only stat display, with an optional tracker agent that syncs equipped items and inventory from the story. Early scaffold — most features are not yet implemented.
